subject: Trinity Biotech: SIG/SOC2 intake & log-sample transfer plan
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@trinitybio.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops@trinitybio.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake & log transfer — scheduling and sample logistics

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the quick response on the intake. We're ready to kick off the SIG/SOC2 intake next week. A couple of asks up front so we can align with our infra team: 

- Can Redwood accept a set of anonymized log samples via S3 presigned URLs (we can host) or would you prefer we upload to a secure transfer link?
- Do you have a preferred retention window for sample logs and any masking requirements (PII/PHI)?
- We'll also attach our initial SIG spreadsheet — we'd like to walk through the high-priority controls first.

Available times (PST): Mon 8/10 10:00–11:00, Tue 8/11 14:00–15:00, Wed 8/12 09:00–09:30. Which works for your team?

Attachment: [trinity-sig-questions-annotated.xlsx (XLSX, 1.2 MB)]

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Director, IT Security
Trinity Biotech

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@trinitybio.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, devops@trinitybio.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake & log transfer — scheduling and sample logistics

Hi Alyssa — thanks, and really glad to get this moving. 

Quick answers to your questions: 
- We prefer S3 presigned URLs for log samples. If Trinity hosts the objects, presigned PUT links are easiest for your infra team. We can also accept encrypted archives via secure upload if that is required by policy.
- Redaction: please remove any direct identifiers (names, SSNs). For PHI — please redact or mask as required by your compliance team. We can accept pseudonymized IDs.
- Retention window: we'll store samples for 30 days by default unless you ask for a shorter retention period. Samples are scoped to this intake and aren't used for model training.

I've proposed the following kickoff slot and added our security engineer to the thread to cover the log-checklist items: 
- Tue 8/11 14:00–15:00 PST (works for our team) — I'll send the calendar invite once you confirm.

Action items for the call: 
1) Walk the attached SIG sheet and mark high-priority questions.
2) Decide sample log scope (apps, auth, audit).
3) Confirm transfer method and key management (KMS vs customer-managed keys).

I'll attach a short guide with presign instructions.

Attachments: [rdw-trinity-presign-instructions.txt (TXT, 4 KB)]

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@trinitybio.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, devops@trinitybio.com
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake & log transfer — scheduling and sample logistics

Hi Alyssa/Sergio — Mina from Redwood security. A few technical clarifications to make the intake efficient: 

- KMS: If Trinity can encrypt archives with your KMS and provide a temporary decryption key via secure link, that's acceptable. Otherwise, presigned PUT to our intake bucket (we'll give you per-upload presigned PUTs) is fine — keys remain customer-provided if you prefer.
- Format: JSON or newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) preferred; if you have compressed tarballs (.tar.gz) that's fine. Please include a small README file describing event schemas.
- Sampling guidance (suggested): 48 hours contiguous from each service (auth, app, db) OR 1% random sample across a 7-day window. Ensure timestamps are in UTC.
- PHI/PCI: redact per your policy. If redaction is non-trivial, we can set up a short call with our compliance engineer and your legal/infosec to define a masking approach.

I'll join the Tue 8/11 slot. Rishi and Marissa — can you confirm we'll be able to run a brief replay/ingest test during the call?

Mina Haddad
Security Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@trinitybio.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, devops@trinitybio.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake & log transfer — scheduling and sample logistics

Hi all — confirmed for Tue 8/11 14:00–15:00 PST. I sent a calendar invite to the thread. Quick mutual action plan so everyone has expectations for the kickoff: 

- Before the call (Alyssa/Trinity): upload 1–2 compressed sample files (<=200MB each) to presigned URLs or share an encrypted archive. Provide README + schema.
- During the call (Redwood): we will do a short ingest smoke test (10–15 mins) with Rishi running the pipeline and Mina validating fields; then we will review SIG items you flagged.
- After the call: our team will produce an evidence pack mapping SIG items to artifacts and assign owners. Target delivery: 5 business days post-call.

Attachments: [log-sample-guidelines.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)]

If you want us to generate the presigned URLs ahead of time, confirm the bucket and object naming pattern and we'll provision them and send a checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@trinitybio.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: devops@trinitybio.com, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@trinitybio.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG intake & log transfer — scheduling and sample logistics

Thanks everyone — confirmed.

Next steps from Trinity side: 
- DevOps will produce two NDJSON samples (auth and app) and upload via the presigned PUT links you will send. They will redact usernames and replace with hashed IDs.
- We'll share a small README and the annotated SIG sheet before the call.

Ben from our infra team will be on the call — he may ping about temporary KMS access. If you can provide the presigned URLs by EOD Monday (8/10) that would be ideal so we can start uploads.

See you on Tue.

Best,
Alyssa
